7/G.goal: Trace the evolution of augmented reality from experimental research to commercial application, explaining the phases, key developments, and driving factors in each stage.
7/G.achieves: Supports the course aim of building foundational XR knowledge by situating augmented reality technologies and applications in their historical development.

7/O1.goal: Describe the progression of augmented reality through its four historical phases, including the key developments, systems, and commercial factors that defined each phase.
7/O1.achieves: Gives learners a historical context for AR tracking, display, interaction, and application technologies, helping them follow later XR system topics.
